properties.description: End to end over the real binary: a registry server holds the named design; the client is started in a code folder with --graph-path .reflow2/graph --shared --only-if-present and REFLOW2_CONFIG_DIR isolated. Three tests: a pointer plus a leftover local store attaches to the named design, the handshake says so, and nothing is spawned for the local store; a pointer naming a design the server does not hold attaches nothing and says which design it holds; an unusable pointer is refused by name and the local store is not opened.
properties.name: a_code_folder_attaches_to_the_design_it_names.rs — with the machine-wide entry's flags, a folder's pointer wins over a leftover store; a wrong design or a bad file attaches nothing
